Definition
[kappa solution definition] Source: kleiner-lott ↗ def:kl-notation-terminology-smooth-closeness-epsilon-necks 1. Definition 47.1\group Kleiner–Lott Kappa Solutions

Fix $\epsilon >0$. With $Q=R(x_0,0)$, $x_0$ is an $\epsilon $-neck center if \[ \{ (x,t):-(\epsilon Q)^{-1}<t\leq 0,\ d_0(x,x_0)^2<(\epsilon Q)^{-1}\} \] after scaling by $Q$ is $\epsilon $-close in the fixed smooth topology to the corresponding evolving round-cylinder region. Let $M_\epsilon $ be the set of points that are not centers of $\epsilon $-necks.
Corollary
[existence for kappa solutions]
